description_zh: ego 车辆（Cruise AV）右转进入无标记道路时，与对向直行的骑行者相撞。选取转弯车辆为 ego 以测试路口转弯让行对向直行骑行车的能力。

source_snippets: While making a right turn onto an unmarked road, the driver of the Cruise AV made contact with a bicyclist traveling in the eastbound, unprotected bicycle lane on Mason Street.
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION VEH 1: D. MAKING RIGHT TURN, VEH 2: B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT
TYPE OF COLLISION VEH 1: D. BROADSIDE
evidence.reason: ego 车辆右转，骑行者在对向自行车道直行，构成路口转弯冲突，现有 junction_turn 及 oncoming 原语可表达。
